title: Buying Clothes
summary: Али шинэ цамц авахаар худалдааны төв очсон ч хямдралтай өмд авсан тухай.

source.name: LIDA Stories
source.credit: Written by Espen Stranger-Johannessen, illustrated by Sara Sahar Haidari · LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph, with very short pages of the same scene merged).

questions.prompt: What does Ali want to buy?
questions.explain: "Ali's shirt is old. He needs a new one" гэж бичсэн. Тэгээд худалдааны төв рүү явсан.

options: On the other side of the mall
On the street next to Ali's house
Outside, across the street from the mall
questions.explain: Худалдагч зааж өгөөд "The clothing store is on the opposite side!" гэж бичсэн. Opposite side гэдэг нь нөгөө тал.

options: His old trousers are too small.
questions.explain: "He buys a new pair of trousers instead because they are on sale" гэж бичсэн. On sale гэдэг нь хямдралтай гэсэн үг.
